title: Verify an authenticated user can retrieve applications
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
expected_result: The response body is a non-empty list.

title: Verify an authenticated user can retrieve the applications summary
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
expected_result: The response body is populated and its potential field is an integer.

title: Verify a user can create and retrieve an application
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: 1. Send POST /api/v1/applications with a valid payload. 2. Send GET /api/v1/applications/{created_id}. 3. Delete the created application as cleanup.
expected_result: The create response is 201 with an integer id, the submitted company_name, and description set to null. The follow-up GET returns the same company_name.

title: Verify a user can update an application
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: 1. Create an application. 2. PATCH its next_action, notes, and status to hired. 3. Delete the application as cleanup.
expected_result: The PATCH response has the created application's id and status hired.

title: Verify a user can delete an application
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: 1. Create an application. 2. Confirm it can be retrieved. 3. DELETE the application. 4. Retrieve it again.
expected_result: The application is initially retrievable with the submitted company_name. The delete request succeeds, and the follow-up GET returns 404.

title: Verify a user can update application notes
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: 1. Create an application. 2. PATCH notes to API Automation Testing. 3. GET the application. 4. Delete it as cleanup.
expected_result: Both the PATCH response and follow-up GET show notes as API Automation Testing.

title: Verify a user can update application remote type
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: 1. Create an application with remote_type on_site. 2. PATCH remote_type to hybrid. 3. GET the application. 4. Delete it as cleanup.
expected_result: Both the PATCH response and follow-up GET show remote_type as hybrid.

title: Verify a user can update application salary range
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: 1. Create an application with salary_range $100k - $130k. 2. PATCH salary_range to $150k - $180k. 3. GET the application. 4. Delete it as cleanup.
expected_result: Both the PATCH response and follow-up GET show salary_range as $150k - $180k.
